Claude Sonnet 5.author: github-actions
Claude Sonnet 5.text:
Summary
Evaluate and integrate Claude Sonnet 5 (model ID: claude-sonnet-5-*) into engine.sh model chains as a potential Sonnet 4.6 replacement. Sonnet 5 launched June 30, 2026 with introductory pricing at $2/$10 per MTok I/O (33% cheaper than Sonnet 4.6 on input) through August 31, and scores 63.2% on SWE-bench Pro vs Sonnet 4.6's 58.1% — an 8.8% coding quality improvement at lower cost.
